bind_addr.description: IP address the metrics exporter should listen on (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '0.0.0.0')

bind_port.description: Port number for the HTTP metrics endpoint

metrics_path.description: Path where metrics are exposed (e.g., '/metrics' or '/ntpd/metrics')

scrape_interval.description: How often (in seconds) the exporter polls ntpd-rs for metrics

scrape_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for a scrape response before timing out

tls_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS/TLS for the metrics endpoint (requires valid cert/key paths)

tls_cert_path.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format) — only used if TLS is enabled

tls_key_path.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format) — only used if TLS is enabled

labels.description: Static key-value labels to attach to all exported metrics (e.g., for environment or cluster identification)

name.description: Label name (must be valid Prometheus label identifier)

extra_filters.description: Optional metric filtering rules to include/exclude metrics by name (regex patterns)

whitelist.description: List of regex patterns; only matching metrics are exported

blacklist.description: List of regex patterns; matching metrics are excluded from export

server_read_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for an HTTP request header/body

server_write_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for an HTTP response write

server_max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous HTTP connections accepted
